requirements.name: Concrete significant benefit and finite entitlement contract
minimumFields: One named source-authorized significant benefit/service/transaction, its actual supported faction and provider, concrete useful result/amount and institutional authority to supply it. A category such as access or prices is not an available service.

Explicit standing and any separate eligibility/permission predicates, terms, actual availability, quantity/capacity, finite entitlement, cost, reservation/consumption and identity of the recipient/account owning it. Do not invent amounts, prices, training, resources or current institutional approval.

A source-qualified continuing or transactional lifecycle: when eligibility is read, what is consumed, how any expiry/denial/cancellation settles, how later standing/history/misconduct affects future use, and which already spent benefits remain spent. No free restock, repeated one-time reward or history deletion on recast.
requirements.sourceEstablished: Standing-v1 maximum+3 and broad institutional benefit categories exist. No automatic rank/RP/strain/recovery benefit is authorized, and no concrete provider/benefit/entitlement record is bound.
requirements.responsibility: Supply an existing authoritative benefit/provider record or separately authorize a clearly labelled finite spell-local benefit contract. This review request prohibits inventing one; no new benefit is selected here. Current provider availability and permission must be supported by the record, not fabricated campaign history.

requirements.name: Complete paid maximum-standing and later benefit-use witness
minimumFields: Bind an actually willing target and nominated supported faction plus a legally acquired/prepared/known native class17+ rank9 caster. Record actual prior standing and untouched membership/office/alliance/invocation fields; no unknown field becomes a factual false or Neutral.

Perform the legal Action/120ft/V,S,F/base26RP cast with actual final RP, class cadence, Counterspell/Reaction and concentration/Ready history where relevant. Show the completed instantaneous standing update to+3, including a genuinely satisfied standing-only predicate while independently established membership/invocation gates remain false.

Demonstrate at least one actual useful W01 benefit interaction with eligibility, availability, payment/consumption and custody/entitlement before and after; then a separate later interaction following source-authorized history/misconduct, preserving independent restrictions, consumed entitlements and any original deadlines.

Provide complete actor/resource/calendar and benefit ledger states plus reversible operations for those interactions. If recast is exercised it is separately paid; it cannot recreate a consumed reward, erase adverse history or hold reputation permanently at maximum.
requirements.sourceEstablished: The selected willing-target, nominated-faction and completed real standing update directions are retained. The two old conditional components have no full cast/payment/calendar or concrete benefit use.
requirements.responsibility: After W01 is defined, assemble source-qualified cast and provider/recipient records and execute a focused integrated witness. Conditional review fixtures must be explicitly authorized and labelled; they are never automatically campaign or user-authored events.

wholeSpellGateReason: The undefined significant benefit is part of the native positive promise, not an optional external edge branch. A maximum-standing-only update cannot stand in for the entire spell.
minimumNextAction: Supply the exact named finite benefit/provider contract and its authorized inputs; then submit only the complete paid maximum-standing/use/later-use witness. Replaying the unchanged conditional components will not close B04.
absenceScope: Missing from the exact reviewed bound evidence; not a finding that no such content could ever be authored.
